TextJPN: レナの家に到着した時には、辺りはすっかり暗くなっていた。
TextENG: When I arrived at Rena's house, the area had become completely dark.

TextJPN: 「ありがとう、ここまで運んでくれて。……ごめんね、こんなに遅くなって」
TextENG: ``Thank you for helping me carry all this. ...And I'm sorry for keeping you so late.``

TextJPN: 「謝るか感謝するか、どっちかにしてくれ。――ちなみに、俺は感謝されるほうが好きだ」
TextENG: ``You need to make up your mind if you want to thank me or apologize to me. ―By the way, I like being thanked more!``

TextJPN: 「はぅ。……ありがとうね、圭一くん」
TextENG: ``Hau. ...Thank you, Keiichi-kun.``

TextJPN: 電灯だけがぼんやりと明るい中、レナはちょこんと恥ずかしそうに首をすくめながら、にこやかに笑ってみせる。暗いのでよくわからないが、きっとその頬は、真っ赤に染まっているのだろう。
TextENG: The only light came from the streetlamps. In this dim atmosphere, Rena shrugged slightly out of embarrassment and showed me a wide smile. I didn't know for sure because it was so dark, but her cheeks must have been bright red.

TextJPN: ……ふとレナの家に、目を向ける。その中は暗く、灯りの気配がなかった。
TextENG: ...I suddenly took a look at Rena's home. It was dark inside, there was no hint of any lamps turned on.

TextJPN: 「……親御さん、まだ帰ってないみたいだな」
TextENG: ``Looks like your parents haven't come home yet.``

TextJPN: 「そうだね。……今日も、遅くなるかもね」
TextENG: ``Yeah. ...It'll probably be late today as well.``

TextJPN: 「忙しいんだな、レナの親御さんって」
TextENG: ``Your parents must be pretty busy.``

TextJPN: ポツリと呟くその口調に、どことなく固い響きを感じる。そういえば、レナの両親って共働きなんだろうか。それに、二人とも家にいないってのは――。
TextENG: Her muttered reply felt somehow stiff to me. Now that I think of it, are both of her parents at work? Given that neither of them are at home―

TextJPN: 「なぁ、レナの親御さんって、何をして――」
TextENG: ``Hey, what are your parents―``

TextJPN: 「あ、圭一くん。もし良かったら、うちでご飯食べていかない？」
TextENG: ``Oh, Keiichi-kun. Would you maybe like to have dinner at my place?``

TextJPN: 「え？　……いいのか？」
TextENG: ``Huh? ...Would that be okay?``

TextJPN: 「うん。ちょっと昨日買い物しすぎちゃったから、一人じゃ食べきれないかもなの。レナ、ご馳走作っちゃうから。ね？」
TextENG: ``Sure. I went a little overboard at the store yesterday, and I don't think I can eat it all myself. I'll make something for you as well. What do you think?``

TextJPN: 曖昧に頷きながら、レナの顔を盗み見る。……暗くてよく見えないが、声も表情も笑顔のはずなのに、この奇妙な気配は……いったい……？
TextENG: I nodded vaguely and took a peek at Rena's face. ...It was too dark to see well, but she should have had a smile both in her voice and on her face, so what was this strange... feeling...?

TextJPN: 「圭一くん……どうしたのかな？　…かな？」
TextENG: ``Keiichi-kun... what's going on? Going on?``

TextJPN: 「え？　あ、いやなんでもない。それじゃ俺、一度家に戻ってくるよ。母さんにも言っておかないとまずいだろうしさ」
TextENG: ``Huh? Ah, nothing. Well, I'll have to go home for a bit, I have to tell my mom that I'll be eating at your place.``

TextJPN: 「うんっ。それじゃ、下ごしらえして待ってるね～」
TextENG: ``Alright. Well then, I'll make some preparations and wait for you~``
